```{r}
# set up the directories
FeatureDir<- c("/home/gdzepedaorozcolab/lab/xxw004/Projects/RawDZscRNAseq/Results/Integration/IntegrationGC/Features/")
setwd(FeatureDir)

# single cell directory
SingleCellObjDir<- c("/home/gdzepedaorozcolab/lab/xxw004/Projects/RawDZscRNAseq/Results/Integration/IntegrationGC/Annotation/IntegrateL1/")

# read the single cell object

CisplatinObj <- readRDS(paste0(SingleCellObjDir,"Cisplatin_GC_Vehicle_Reclustered_MarkerAnnot_L1Harmonised_NoVehGC_Weighted_FinalAnnotation.RDS"))
head(CisplatinObj@meta.data)

colnames(CisplatinObj@meta.data)

Idents(CisplatinObj) <- CisplatinObj$FinalAnnotation_HC
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

# we checked the cell cycle score of the datsets
```{r}

setwd("/home/gdzepedaorozcolab/lab/xxw004/Projects/RawDZscRNAseq/Results/Integration/IntegrationGC/Features/CellCycles/")

cell.cycle.tirosh <- read.csv("http://genomedata.org/rnaseq-tutorial/scrna/CellCycleTiroshSymbol2ID.csv", header=TRUE); # read in the list of genes

write.csv(cell.cycle.tirosh, file = "CellCycleTiroshSymbol2ID.csv")

### convert the gene id from human into mouse
head(cell.cycle.tirosh)
dim(cell.cycle.tirosh)

cell.cycle.tirosh$Gene.Symbol <- stringr::str_to_title(cell.cycle.tirosh$Gene.Symbol)

# Fix deprecated mouse gene aliases (official MGI renames)
alias_map <- c(Mlf1ip = "Cenpu", Fam64a = "Pimreg", Hn1 = "Jpt1")
cell.cycle.tirosh$Gene.Symbol <- dplyr::recode(cell.cycle.tirosh$Gene.Symbol, !!!alias_map)

# ignore the NxA in the cell cycles
cell.cycle.tirosh = cell.cycle.tirosh %>% na.omit()

cell.cycle.tirosh
dim(cell.cycle.tirosh)

### create the S-phage and G2/M phage genes
s.genes = cell.cycle.tirosh$Gene.Symbol[which(cell.cycle.tirosh$List == "G1/S")]; # create a vector of S-phase genes
length(s.genes)
g2m.genes = cell.cycle.tirosh$Gene.Symbol[which(cell.cycle.tirosh$List == "G2/M")]; # create a vector of G2/M-phase genes
length(g2m.genes)

CisplatinObj <- CellCycleScoring(object=CisplatinObj, s.features=s.genes, g2m.features=g2m.genes, set.ident=TRUE)
CisplatinObj@meta.data %>% head()

# visualize the mitochondrial rate across samples
MitichondrionRate<- FeaturePlot(CisplatinObj, features = "percent.mt",split.by = "DataSet") * theme(legend.position = "right")     
ggsave("MitochondrialRate_Featureplot.pdf", plot=MitichondrionRate, height = 5, width = 12)

# Violin plot of S.Score
percent.mtVolin<-ggplot(CisplatinObj@meta.data, aes(x=FinalAnnotation_HC, y=percent.mt, fill=DataSet)) +
  geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="percent.mt")
ggsave("MitochondrialRate_Volinplot.pdf", plot=percent.mtVolin, height = 5, width = 12)

# check the Score
S.ScoreFeature<- FeaturePlot(CisplatinObj, features = "S.Score",split.by = "DataSet") * theme(legend.position = "right")     
ggsave("S.Score_Featureplot.pdf", plot=S.ScoreFeature, height = 5, width = 12)

G2M.ScoreFeature<- FeaturePlot(CisplatinObj, features = "G2M.Score",split.by = "DataSet") * theme(legend.position = "right")     
ggsave("G2M.Score_Featureplot.pdf", plot=G2M.ScoreFeature, height = 5, width = 12)


## visualize the grouping by cell cycle phages
pdf("CellCylcle_phages_cluster.pdf", height = 5, width = 10)
CisplatinObj@meta.data
DimPlot(CisplatinObj, reduction = "umap", split.by = "DataSet", group.by="Phase")
dev.off()

CisplatinObj@meta.data %>% dplyr::select_all(Phage, DataSet)

# draw the G2M.Score, S score for each cell type under two condition
avg_scores <- CisplatinObj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(FinalAnnotation_HC, DataSet) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_S = mean(S.Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_G2M = mean(G2M.Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

avg_scores

# Violin plot of S.Score
SScore<-ggplot(CisplatinObj@meta.data, aes(x=FinalAnnotation_HC, y=S.Score, fill=DataSet)) +
  geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="S Phase Score")
ggsave("PhageFraction_SScore_Celltype_Condition.pdf", plot = SScore, height = 4, width = 10)
# Similarly for G2M.Score
G2MScore <- ggplot(CisplatinObj@meta.data, aes(x=FinalAnnotation_HC, y=G2M.Score, fill=DataSet)) +
  geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="G2M Phase Score")
ggsave("PhageFraction_G2MScore_Celltype_Condition.pdf", plot = G2MScore, height = 4, width = 10)
phase_fraction <- CisplatinObj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(FinalAnnotation_HC, DataSet, Phase) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(FinalAnnotation_HC, DataSet) %>%
  mutate(fraction = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

phase_fraction
PhageFraction <-ggplot(phase_fraction, aes(x=FinalAnnotation_HC, y=fraction, fill=Phase)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack") +
  facet_wrap(~DataSet) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="Fraction of cells", x="Cell Type", fill="Cell Cycle Phase")

ggsave("PhageFraction_Celltype_Condition.pdf", plot = PhageFraction, height = 4, width = 12)


## for previous cluster:

# Violin plot of S.Score
SScore<-ggplot(CisplatinObj@meta.data, aes(x=Sub2, y=S.Score, fill=DataSet)) +
  geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="S Phase Score")
ggsave("PhageFraction_SScore_Celltype_Condition_seurat_clusters.pdf", plot = SScore, height = 4, width = 10)
# Similarly for G2M.Score
G2MScore <- ggplot(CisplatinObj@meta.data, aes(x=Sub2, y=G2M.Score, fill=DataSet)) +
  geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="G2M Phase Score")
ggsave("PhageFraction_G2MScore_Celltype_Condition_seurat_clusters.pdf", plot = G2MScore, height = 4, width = 10)
phase_fraction_2 <- CisplatinObj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters, DataSet, Phase) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters, DataSet) %>%
  mutate(fraction = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

PhageFraction <-ggplot(phase_fraction_2, aes(x=Sub2, y=fraction, fill=Phase)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack") +
  facet_wrap(~DataSet) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y="Fraction of cells", x="Cell Type", fill="Cell Cycle Phase")

ggsave("PhageFraction_Celltype_Condition_seurat_clusters.pdf", plot = PhageFraction, height = 4, width = 12)
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:length(EGFSignaling)) {
  # Kidney Status type name
  #i=18
  EGFSignalingType <- names(EGFSignaling[i])
  #ImmuneCellType <- "Mast_cells"
  # create a director for the cell type
  EGFSignalingTypeDir <- paste0(FeatureDir,
        EGFSignalingType,"/")
  dir.create(EGFSignalingTypeDir,showWarnings = FALSE)
  setwd(EGFSignalingTypeDir)
  
  DPlots<- DotPlot(CisplatinObj, features =EGFSignaling[[EGFSignalingType]] )+RotatedAxis()
  ggsave(paste0(EGFSignalingTypeDir, EGFSignalingType, "_ReDotPlot.pdf"), plot= DPlots,height = 8, width = 6)
 
  # generate each feature
  #ImmuneDiffType[[ImmuneCellType]]
  for (j in EGFSignaling[[EGFSignalingType]]) {
    
    
    # ignore the genes if they are not exists
      # generate the distribution from the single cells
    #rownames(CisplatinObj)
   if (!(j %in% rownames(CisplatinObj[["RNA"]]))) {
     next
     }
    
    FeaturePlots <-
      FeaturePlot(CisplatinObj, features =  j, order =TRUE) + RotatedAxis()
    ggsave(
      paste0(
        EGFSignalingTypeDir,
        EGFSignalingType,
        "_",
        j,
        "_Feature_GeneMarkers_ReAnnoatation.pdf"
      ),
      plot = FeaturePlots,
      height = 5,
      width = 5
    )
    
    FeaturePlotsSplit <-
      FeaturePlot(CisplatinObj, features =  j, order =TRUE, split.by = "DataSet") + RotatedAxis()
    ggsave(
      paste0(
        EGFSignalingTypeDir,
        EGFSignalingType,
        "_",
        j,
        "_Feature_GeneMarkers_ReAnnoatation_SplitData.pdf"
      ),
      plot = FeaturePlotsSplit,
      height = 5,
      width = 10
    )
    
    # add the violin plot
    VlnPlotsSplit <- VlnPlot(CisplatinObj, features  = j,split.by = "DataSet")
    
    ggsave(
      paste0(
        EGFSignalingTypeDir,
        EGFSignalingType,
        "_",
        j,
        "_VlnPlot_GeneMarkers_ReAnnoatation_SplitData.pdf"
      ),
      plot = VlnPlotsSplit,
      height = 5,
      width = 10
    )
  }
  
}
```

```{r}
RequestGeneList <- MitETCGenes$Symbol.x
requestPathway <- "MitochondrialEncodeGenes"
RequestGeneList <-MitEncodeGenes$Symbol.x

expr <- FetchData(CisplatinObj, vars = c("FinalAnnotation","DataSet",RequestGeneList))

# 
# expr <- FetchData(CisplatinObj, vars = c("FinalAnnotation","DataSet","Egf","Egfr","Erbb2","Erbb3","Erbb4"))
# 
# 
FinalExpGeneList <- colnames(expr)[3:length(colnames(expr))]
length(FinalExpGeneList)
# expr <- FetchData(CisplatinObj, vars = c("FinalAnnotation","DataSet","Egf","Erbb4","Hbegf","Pik3c2g","Akt1","Mtor","Rps6kb1"))
# # Convert to long format
expr_long <- expr %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(FinalExpGeneList),
                      names_to = "gene",
                      values_to = "expression")
# expr_long <- expr %>%
#   tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Egf","Erbb4","Hbegf","Pik3c2g","Akt1","Mtor","Rps6kb1"),
#                       names_to = "gene",
#                       values_to = "expression")
# 
# 
# expr_long <- expr %>%
#   tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Egf","Egfr","Erbb2","Erbb3","Erbb4"),
#                       names_to = "gene",
#                       values_to = "expression")

expr_long$DataSet
# Compute average per celltype and condition
pct_expr <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(FinalAnnotation, DataSet, gene) %>%
  summarize(
    avg = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct = mean(expression > 0) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )



SelectedGeneConditionCompareDotPlot<-ggplot(pct_expr, aes(x = gene, y = FinalAnnotation, size = pct, color = avg)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~DataSet) +
  #scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey", high = "darkred") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "#B2182B")+
  #scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma")+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(paste0(requestPathway,"_Condition_DotPlot.pdf"), plot = SelectedGeneConditionCompareDotPlot, height = 6, width = 6)
# ggsave("Egf_Erbb4_Hbegf_Condition_DotPlot.pdf", plot = SelectedGeneConditionCompareDotPlot, height = 6, width = 6)
# ggsave("Egf_Erbb4_Hbegf_PI3K_AKT_mTOR_Condition_DotPlot.pdf", plot = SelectedGeneConditionCompareDotPlot, height = 6, width = 8)
# ggsave("Egf_Erbb1_4_Condition_DotPlot.pdf", plot = SelectedGeneConditionCompareDotPlot, height = 6, width = 8)

VlnPlot(CisplatinObj, features = RequestGeneList, split.by = "DataSet")

# put the fold changes and p value for the visualization
# calculate the p value and fold changes for each genes
pct_expr_pvalue <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(gene,FinalAnnotation) %>%
  summarize(
    p_value = tryCatch(wilcox.test(expression ~ DataSet)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    LogFoldChange = log2(mean(expression[DataSet == "Cisplatin"]) / mean(expression[DataSet == "Vehicle"])),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Use the p-values and fold changes to draw the DotPlot with significance stars
pct_expr_pvalue <- pct_expr_pvalue %>%
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05  ~ "*"
  ),
  sig_size = case_when(
    p_value < 0.001 ~ 4,
    p_value < 0.01  ~ 3,
    p_value < 0.05  ~ 2,
    TRUE            ~ 1
  ))

SelectedGeneConditionCompareDotPlotPvalue<- ggplot(pct_expr_pvalue, aes(x = gene, y = FinalAnnotation, size = sig_size, color = LogFoldChange)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 3, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  #scale_size_continuous(name = "Significance", breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("*", "**", "***"), range = c(3, 10)) +
  #facet_wrap(~DataSet) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "lightblue", high = "#B2182B", mid = "white",midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),     panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.15),  # 主网格线变细
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.15)) # 次网格线更细)  # 去掉次网格线)

ggsave(paste0(requestPathway,"_Condition_DotPlot_PvalueFC.pdf"), plot = SelectedGeneConditionCompareDotPlotPvalue, height = 5, width = 4)

write.csv(x = pct_expr_pvalue, file = "MitETCEncodingGenes_pct_expr_pvalue.csv")
```
